entities.summary: A Wolf–Rayet nebula is a type of nebula created from stellar winds expelled by Wolf–Rayet stars. Wolf–Rayet stars are very hot, highly luminous, and rapidly evolving massive stars that are fusing helium or heavier elements in their cores.
